subject.title: fix(cli-runner): sweep orphaned bundle MCP temp dirs at gateway startup

question: After the branch is refreshed, is exact-head Linux process proof plus cross-platform unit coverage sufficient for enabling this startup deletion path on every supported platform?
rationale: The Linux mechanism is well proven, but Windows uses a distinct process-discovery implementation and false orphan classification could remove configuration still needed by a surviving CLI child.

options.title: Require Windows smoke proof
options.body: Ask for one real Windows run proving a surviving child is retained and a dead-owner directory is reclaimed before merge.

options.title: Accept conservative coverage
options.body: Merge after rebase and green checks, accepting unit coverage and fail-closed over-protection as sufficient for non-Linux platforms.

recommendation.title: Require Windows smoke proof
recommendation.body: Ask for one real Windows run proving a surviving child is retained and a dead-owner directory is reclaimed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They reworked and landed the adjacent bundle-MCP cleanup lifecycle and are the strongest available owner for the proof threshold.
